comparisonContract.columns: Every snapshot must have the registered column names and CLR types.
comparisonContract.values: Every registered row value, including NULL, must match.
comparisonContract.multiplicity: Unordered results are compared as bags, so duplicate counts must match.
comparisonContract.ordering: Ordered results are compared as sequences; unordered results do not claim an order.
comparisonContract.meaningChange: Each repaired query must differ from its gold query under the frozen shape/result contract while still compiling and running.

policyContract.strictConversion: Invalid strict casts must retain failure behavior; ToInt32 may return NULL and is not an equivalent repair.
policyContract.interpretation: Invalid Parse input must retain failure behavior; outer TryParse may return NULL and is not an equivalent repair.
policyContract.validControls: Strict and soft conversion, and Parse and TryParse, are compared only on valid input to confirm the controls distinguish policy from value equivalence.

history.reason: Initial execution exposed SQL NULL negation and UNION ALL multiplicity, including NULL rows from both operands; the expected results were corrected before final replay.
A no-build replay used the assembly from the initial observation and therefore did not execute the registered source revision; it is excluded from candidate evidence.
Self-review found that the replaced-constant family needed more than one fixture kind to satisfy O01 explicitly; two cases now use ConstantRowsAlt.
